claimant: ILI Group (via press coverage of The Stoics launch)
preferred_rationale: The 540MW figure appears consistently across developer-derived press coverage, SPICe, APRS and the local campaign group, but no primary planning or grid document defining what the figure measures has been located.
notes: The PAN description (25/0008/PREAPP) does not state a MW figure. The metric behind 540MW (IT load vs grid import vs connection application) is undisclosed.

SPICe describes the Rufus project as 'badged as 540MW', interpreting MW as the maximum power the facility could draw at any point in time (i.e. an import-capacity style reading). This is SPICe's interpretation of the developer's badge figure, not an independent grid record.
ILI states each Stoics site 'has secured grid connection'; no MW value, network operator, or connection agreement evidence is published for Rufus.
